title: Intel OT-ST7308 PCIe x4 Quad RJ45 Gigabit i350-T4 Ethernet Network Card

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Intel® I350 Quad-Port Gigabit Ethernet Server Adapter | High-Performance Networking Solution

Next-Level Performance for Enterprise & Data Centers
The Intel® I350 Quad-Port Gigabit Ethernet Server Adapter is a cutting-edge networking solution, designed to deliver exceptional speed, scalability, and energy efficiency. This high-performance Gigabit Ethernet (GbE) adapter is optimized for virtualization, iSCSI storage, and unified networking, making it ideal for enterprise networks, data centers, and cloud environments.

Key Features 

  • Quad-Port Gigabit Ethernet Adapter – Supports high-speed networking with RJ-45 Copper & Fiber interfaces
  • Advanced Power Management – Features Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) & DMA Coalescing (DMAC) for reduced power consumption
  • Flexible I/O Virtualization – Supports port partitioning & QoS for up to 32 virtual ports
  • Scalable iSCSI Performance – Delivers cost-effective SAN connectivity for storage networks
  • PCI Express 2.1 (x4 lane, operable in x4, x8, x16 slots) – Ensures high-speed 5GT/s data transfer
  • Reliable & Proven Intel® Gigabit Technology – Designed for enterprise-grade reliability
  • High-Performing Bridgeless Design – Optimized for virtualized environments
  • Supports Windows & Linux OS – Compatible with Windows Server 2022, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, RHEL, SLES, FreeBSD, and more

Technical Specifications

  • Product Collection: Intel® I350 Ethernet Server Adapter
  • Controller: Intel® NHI350T2V2
  • Bus Type & Width: PCI Express 2.1 (5 GT/s), x4 lanes
  • Ports: 4 x RJ-45 (Copper)
  • Data Rate Supported: 10/100/1000 Mbps (Copper), 1000 Mbps (Fiber)

Cabling Support:

  • Copper: Up to 100m (Cat-5e or higher for 1000BASE-T)
  • Fiber: MMF 62.5/50µm
  • Bracket: Full-height installed, low-profile bracket included
  • Dimensions: 155 mm x 68 mm (PCIe Board)

Why Choose the Intel® I350 Quad-Port Server Adapter?

  • Optimized for Enterprise & Cloud Networks – Ensures high-speed, reliable connectivity
  • Ideal for Virtualized & Unified Networking Environments – Supports QoS, iSCSI, and I/O virtualization
  • Energy-Efficient Design – Reduces power consumption without compromising performance
  • Proven Intel® Quality & Stability – Trusted Intel networking technology for mission-critical applications
